main.description: This device rings for the caller from now on. A subscription belongs to the device, so whoever signs in on it next takes it over. The fields are what `PushManager.subscribe` hands back, its keys base64url without padding.

endpoint.description: https, on a push service's DNS name.

p256dh.description: The device's public key: a 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Not a push service's endpoint, or keys of the wrong size.
